elements.label: hand
elements.description: [KK] The cold invisible hand that guides all things. The Hand is the principle that controls everything. The fourth principle in ALOK, which the other principles feed into.

elements.label: Veneration: Imbalance
elements.description: This organization follows the principle of the eternal accumulation, wearing down the world for their alien overlords.

elements.label: Veneration: Catgirl
elements.description: This organization follows the principle of the Immortal Catgirl.

elements.label: Veneration: Hand
elements.description: This organization follows the principle of the Hand, utilizing its influence to guide and manipulate economies, probabilities, and realities, charting the course of destiny unseen by most.

elements.label: Veneration: Secret Histories
elements.description: This organization explores the principle of Secret Histories, using Enlensing to unearth hidden truths, find obscured meanings, and approach mysteries from fresh perspectives.

elements.label: Heart
elements.description: [AA] The Heart represents vitality, emotion, and human connection. Just as Heart bolsters power with human bonds and emotions, The Pride aims to bridge alienation and restore communal unity.

elements.label: Winter
elements.description: [AL] The Winter aspect mirrors the calming effect of the Inner Dialogue, akin to a period of mental hibernation where individuals process emotions and experiences, creating a soothing refuge from anxiety.

elements.label: Secret Histories
elements.description: [AO] Secret Histories correspond to hidden truths and obscured knowledge, mirroring the aim of Enlensing to reframe perspectives, seeking hidden meanings, and approaching life's mysteries with a fresh lens.

elements.label: Lantern
elements.description: [LA] The Lantern embodies enlightenment, understanding, and knowledge. Remembering shares this focus on illumination, bringing obscured or forgotten experiences back into the light.

elements.label: Grail
elements.description: [LL] The Grail symbolizes desire and physical experiences. Counter-Spiralling, aligns well with the Grail, offering a broader, more enriching view of life through diverse experiences.

elements.label: Edge
elements.description: [LO] The Edge stands for overcoming challenges, synonymous with Flow, representing the endeavor to overcome the sensation of drowning in one's problems, achieving a state of effortless performance.

elements.label: Knock
elements.description: [OA] The Knock signifies transitions and the overcoming of barriers, finds a counterpart in Antibodies, providing a way to neutralize harmful foreign influences, liberating individuals from the chains of external entrapment.

elements.label: Forge
elements.description: [OL] The Forge stands for transformation and change, paralleling the process of Ego Loosening. This aspect echoes the personal metamorphosis facilitated by Ego Loosening, underscoring the value of adaptability and self-reinvention.

elements.label: Moth
elements.description: [OO] The Moth represents secrets, dreams, transformation, and elusive elements, aligns with the concept of Larping, promoting a fluid identity by stepping into different roles and perspectives.

elements.label: Dance
elements.description: Older than language, younger than life.

elements.label: Imbalance
elements.description: Alien, and not in a good way.

elements.label: Not quite dead
elements.description: Can be frozen but will otherwise die. [Work using Winter and Moth lore with your HQ to start a cryonics facility.]

elements.label: Frozen
elements.description: Someday they will wake up again.

elements.label: Facility
elements.description: A facility of our HQ. Can be moved

elements.label: Man in Black Ascension
elements.description: Alien, and not in a good way.

elements.label: Local
elements.description: Local to the city. If you leave it will not follow.

elements.label: Written in Latin
elements.description: A dead language: dead as diamonds. [Some books must be translated before they can be read.]

elements.label: Written in Fucine
elements.description: A people lived east of the lost lake Fucino. Horace warned that theirs was the land of witches. This was their language, called by some 'the dry tongue' and by others 'the tongue of witches'. [Some books must be translated before they can be read.]

elements.label: Written in Greek
elements.description: A tongue for philosophers, theologians and heroes. [Some books must be translated before they can be read.]

elements.label: Written in Phrygian
elements.description: The Phrygians worshipped the Great Mother, who we call the Grail. Theirs was the land in which the Sisterhood of the Knot was born, and this is the tongue in which the Thunderskin pleaded, at his ascension. [Some books must be translated before they can be read.]

elements.label: Written in Aramaic
elements.description: The language of Aram, and all her many children these three thousand years and more. [Some books must be translated before they can be read.]

elements.label: Written in Deep Mandaic
elements.description: The most secret script of the innermost rites of the deep sects of the deep desert. The birth-tongue, it is claimed, of the Mother of Ants herself. [Some books must be translated before they can be read.]

elements.label: Written in Sanskrit
elements.description: The holy tongue of the Subcontinent. The door to four thousand years of poetry, ceremony and mystery now opens before you, if you can struggle through the lotus convolutions of its vocabulary. [Some books must be translated before they can be read.]

elements.label: Written in Vak
elements.description: Before gods arose from blood, before ever ape stood upright, this was the language heard in the House of the Sun.[Some books must be translated before they can be read.]

elements.label: A good location for a date
elements.description: Take a follower with an aligning interest here for a date. [Check their elemental affinities.]

elements.label: A double agent
elements.description: Serves the hand and will betray you if you switch sides
